title: The Fine Art Of Small Talk

questions.q: What acronym helps choose small‑talk topics?
questions.why: The book uses FORM: Family, Occupation, Recreation, Miscellaneous.

questions.q: Which body language cue shows you are listening?
What is the second biggest social fear in the Western world?
questions.why: The text states initiating conversation is the second biggest fear.

questions.q: Which question type should be avoided for a good conversation?
questions.why: Yes/no questions are discouraged unless followed up.

questions.q: Who is the author of the small‑talk guide?
questions.why: Debra Fine wrote The Fine Art Of Small Talk.
